description: Official list of the 103 communities (ชุมชน) of Hat Yai City Municipality grouped by the 4 zones (เขต 1-4), transcribed from the municipality's PDFs 'ข้อมูลประธานกรรมการชุมชน เขต 1-4' (data as of 1 ตุลาคม 2569 = 2026-10-01). Only community names and zone assignment are kept; personal data in the source (chairperson names and phone numbers) is deliberately NOT transcribed.

transcription.method: The PDF text layer (macOS PDFKit) drops Thai upper marks (tone marks, mai han-akat, thanthakhat) that the font renders through private-use glyph variants. Names were therefore transcribed visually from 4x renders of each page and cross-checked automatically by scripts/data/fetch-hatyai.ts: after removing all Thai combining marks, every name must equal the PDF text-layer string at the same row. Digits are kept exactly as the text layer encodes them (Arabic or Thai digits); nameThNormalized converts Thai digits to Arabic and collapses spaces.
transcription.transcribedBy: Claude (AI) for the Urban Intelligence demo; verify before official use
transcription.verification: Re-checked 2026-11-04: the text layer does not actually lose the marks — it encodes them as Thai private-use-area glyph variants (U+F705, U+F706, U+F70A-U+F70C, U+F70E, U+F710 occur in these PDFs). After fetch-hatyai.ts maps those code points to standard Unicode (puaToThai), all 103 transcribed names equal the text-layer strings EXACTLY (0 mismatches; see data/staged/hatyai-ingest-report.json checks.officialNamesVsChairmenTextLayer). The earlier 'mismatches' (e.g. ชุมชนหนาสวนสาธารณะ vs ชุมชนหน้าสวนสาธารณะ) were extraction artefacts from dropping those PUA glyphs; the names in this file are the correct ones.
